name: How to Set Up IPTV on Fire Stick 2026
description: Step-by-step guide to set up IPTV with StreamStickPro.

step.name: Get credentials
step.text: Sign up for StreamStickPro and receive your M3U or Xtream login.

step.name: Install app
step.text: Install TiviMate or use a pre-configured Fire Stick.

step.name: Enter credentials
step.text: Add your playlist URL or Xtream codes in the app.
